claim: Antitrust plaintiffs satisfy the predominance requirement for class certification by using a damages model that estimates damages attributable to the antitrust injury on a class-wide basis, even if individualized determinations are later needed to allocate damages among class members.
initial_reasoning: In In Re Bystolic Antitrust Litigation, the court held that a damages model estimating class‑wide damages attributable to the antitrust injury satisfies the predominance requirement, and that individualized determinations may be made later to allocate damages among class members.
